title: Payment failed notice
description: Tell customers a subscription payment failed on WhatsApp, with next retry date and a link to update their card. Utility template.
notes: State the amount, last 4 digits and retry date. A single update-card link is all you need.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, we could not process your *{{amount}}* payment for {{plan}} using the card ending in {{last4}}. We will try again on {{retry_date}}. Update your card to avoid interruption.
